subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin support individual user OAuth, administrator-controlled delegated authentication, or remain service-account-only for reactions, uploads, and email-alias direct-message lookup?
rationale: Google supports the requested operations through user authentication, but the durable credential, consent, least-privilege scope, and dual-auth routing contract are security-sensitive product choices that current repository behavior does not define. citeturn836763search0turn836763search1turn836763search4turn836763search7

options.title: Support least-privilege user OAuth
options.body: Add SecretRef-aware user credentials and operation-specific scopes and routing while retaining service-account authentication as the default.

options.title: Support delegated enterprise auth
options.body: Limit enhanced operations to administrator-approved domain-wide delegation or another centrally managed Workspace identity model.

options.title: Keep service-account-only
options.body: Decline native user-auth operations and improve unsupported-operation warnings and degraded media-link delivery instead.

recommendation.title: Support least-privilege user OAuth
recommendation.body: Add SecretRef-aware user credentials and operation-specific scopes and routing while retaining service-account authentication as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined signal from current integration history and the prior review of this exact product decision.
